描述_EN: at least four of the 29 fragments are of a different design, showing an overall scattering of small yellow butterflies on dark red. these fragments are of bi-coloured pattern woven silk showing widely spaced yellow roundels. the v&a has around 650 ancient and medieval textiles recovered from the silk road by stein at the beginning of the20th century. this shrine site is one of china's great buddhist pilgrimage complexes and is situated near the oasis town of dunhuang. the site is also part of an area of central asia we now call the silk road, a series of overland trade routes that crossed asia from china to europe. whilst silk textiles travelled west from china, buddhism entered china from india in this way. camels and horses were used as pack animals and merchants passed the goods from oasis to oasis. this textile was brought back from central asia by the explorer and archaeologist sir marc aurel stein (1862-1943). the most notable item traded was silk. the silk road was also important for the exchange of ideas. they were recovered from cave 17 of the mogao grottoes. some are silk while others are made from the wool of a variety of different animals. the original function of these fragments is unknown although they are likely to have had a decorative purpose. the roundels have a design of a phoenix and leaves, against a red ground.
描述_ZN: 29块碎片中至少有4块是不同的设计，显示出暗红色上的小黄蝶的整体散布。 886¥这些碎片是由双色花纹织成的丝绸，显示出间隔较远的黄色圆环。 V&A有大约650件古代和中世纪的纺织品，是斯坦在20世纪初从丝绸之路上找到的。 该圣地是中国伟大的佛教朝圣地之一，位于敦煌绿洲镇附近。 该遗址也是中亚地区的一部分，我们现在称之为丝绸之路，这是一系列从中国到欧洲穿越亚洲的陆上贸易路线。 年，当丝织品从中国西行时，佛教通过这种方式从印度进入中国。 年，骆驼和马被用作驮运动物，商人们在绿洲之间传递货物。 年，这个纺织品被探险家和考古学家Marc Aurel Stein先生（1862-1943）从中亚带回来。 年，最引人注目的贸易项目是丝绸。 年：丝绸之路对于思想的交流也很重要。 它们是在莫高窟第17窟中发现的。 有些是丝绸，有些则是由各种不同动物的羊毛制成。 这些碎片的原始功能是未知的，尽管它们可能有装饰的目的。 这些圆环有一个凤凰和叶子的图案，衬着红色的地面。
